# Native platform report provenance

These are reports generated by real native runners on 2026-10-01. Host names
were replaced with `fixture-host`, private scratch roots with `/fixture`, and
JUnit JVM system properties were removed. Outcome records, test identities,
counts and failure messages are retained. The unchanged raw evidence and source
fixtures are in `/private/tmp/cem10-build/platform` for this build session.

| Fixture | Actual producer | Native invocation / result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| jupiter.xml | JUnit Platform Console Standalone 6.1.3, Java 17.0.20.1 | `execute --select-class MatrixTest --reports-dir ...`; exit 1; pass, assertion failure, exception, disabled |
| vintage.xml | JUnit Vintage via Console 6.1.3 | `execute --select-class ClassicTest --reports-dir ...`; exit 1; assertion failure |
| testng.xml | TestNG 7.12.0 | `org.testng.TestNG -testclass NgTest -usedefaultlisteners false -reporter org.testng.reporters.XMLReporter -d ...`; exit 3; pass, assertion failure, exception, skip |
| swift.jsonl | Swift 6.4 / Swift Testing, Xcode 27.0 | `swift test --disable-xctest --enable-swift-testing --no-parallel --event-stream-version 0 --event-stream-output-path ...`; exit 1; pass, expectation failure, disabled |
| bats.tap | Bats Core 1.14.0 | `bats --formatter tap matrix.bats`; exit 1; pass, failure, skip |
| shellspec.xml | ShellSpec 0.28.1 | `shellspec --shell /bin/sh --format junit --no-color matrix_spec.sh`; exit 101; pass, expectation failure, skip |
| xcode-tests.json / xcode-summary.json | Xcode 27.0, xcresulttool schema 0.4.0 | `xcodebuild test -destination platform=macOS ... CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`; exit 65; Swift and Objective-C XCTest pass, assertion failure, skip; native xcresulttool tests and summary views |

These fixtures verify native decoding. They do not qualify mutation adequacy,
all framework features, other runtime versions, devices or language variants.
Unsupported retries, parameterization or report dialects must retain uncertainty.
SwiftPM XCTest XML is intentionally unavailable: a real skipped case was emitted
as an ordinary passing XML testcase. The xcresult profile only qualifies macOS
Swift and Objective-C XCTest at this stage; UI/device profiles need own proofs.

Additional actual native witnesses in this change:

- `gradle.xml`: Gradle 9.6.1 fixed init script, Java/Jupiter four-case matrix,
  exit 1. Native Gradle writes ordinary exceptions as failure elements.
- `surefire.xml`: Maven 3.9.16, Surefire 3.6.0, report version 3.0.2; the same
  four cases, exit 1, rerun with offline mode and a fresh report directory.
- `kotlin-junit.xml` and `kotest.xml`: Kotlin 2.4.0 compiled JVM fixtures,
  kotlin-test-junit5 2.4.0 and Kotest 6.2.5, Console 6.1.3; each has pass,
  assertion failure, exception and skip. These also ran through shared Execute.
- `android.txt` / `android-zero.txt`: AndroidJUnitRunner 1.7.0, local API 36
  phone emulator; raw `am instrument -w -r`, exit 0 even with native failures.
- `uiautomator.txt`: UIAutomator 2.3.0 actually queried the task-owned app view.
- `espresso.txt`: Espresso 3.5.1 actually asserted the task-owned view on the
  healthy TV emulator; pass, native assertion failure and skip.
- `espresso-infrastructure.txt`: original phone emulator SystemUI ANR prevented
  window focus; both active examples failed with RootViewWithoutFocusException.
  This is retained infrastructure evidence, never a passing or assertion witness.

The Android APKs use only the task-owned package `local.corvint.cem10proof` and
its `.test` instrumentation package. Raw APK hashes and emulator fingerprints are
retained in the private build evidence; installed proof packages are removed after
qualification. Existing emulator applications and the SystemUI ANR are preserved.

The swift-xctest-* fixtures are original SwiftPM 6.4/macOS serial XCTest stdout,
including multiple assertions in one method, thrown error, skip, setup failure,
empty no-match output and empty compiler-failure stdout. Scratch path prefixes
are replaced with /fixture. `swift-xctest-three.txt` is the shared-executor stdout
of Swift 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1, macOS 26.6.2 25G83, arm64) for exact pass,
XCTAssertEqual failure and XCTSkip selectors, exit 1. `swiftpm-xunit-parallel.xml`
is the unmodified `swift test --enable-xctest --disable-swift-testing --parallel
--xunit-output` file from the same package and toolchain, exit 1: it reports the
skip as a pass and is retained only as a negative witness (V1-0597). Robolectric fixtures come from Robolectric 4.16.1,
API 35 and Console 6.1.3 Vintage: four native cases, missing Android runtime
initialization failure, and zero selected tests. JVM properties/host identifiers
are removed; native identities, outcomes, counts and diagnostics are retained.
